svg.title: Debrecen full-city superblock optimization
svg.desc: A stylized overview of Debrecen's full-city superblock partition with highlighted modified corridors and a downtown focus inset.
svg.text: Streaming full partition result · highlighted superblocks, arterial structure, and calmed corridors

g.text: The partition channels through-traffic to arterials and turns interior corridors into local-access streets.
arterial backbone retained for citywide movement
modal filters and street cuts on local corridors
superblock cells colored by district for legibility

svg.text: Source metrics: 13,693 drivable edges · 2,451.4 km baseline network · 952.9 km arterial spine
